title: kate-text: History (undo/redo groups, coalescing, saved-state tracking)
summary: Undo as a stack of HistoryEntry, each holding a forward Transaction and its inverse plus the selection ranges before and after. Coalescing merges adjacent typing or adjacent deletion into one entry; everything else is its own entry. Modified-state is tracked by undo-stack depth at save time, not by a boolean that drifts.

lane.reason: Pure library logic with property tests; same lane as the two packets before it because it touches the same crate and must land after them.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: New module. History does not own the buffer; it borrows it for undo/redo so that Document (PKT-0012) can own both as plain fields.

regression_tests.name: history::tests::undo_redo_round_trip_restores_text_and_ranges
regression_tests.asserts: For random edit sequences, undoing all entries restores the original text, redoing all restores the final text, and the returned ranges equal those recorded.

regression_tests.name: history::tests::coalesces_adjacent_single_char_inserts
regression_tests.asserts: Typing 'a','b','c' at consecutive offsets yields one undo entry; one undo removes all three.

regression_tests.name: history::tests::saved_state_tracks_undo_depth
regression_tests.asserts: Edit, mark_saved, edit, undo -> is_modified() is false; undo again -> true; edit after undo past the saved depth -> saved state unreachable, stays modified.

regression_tests.name: history::tests::new_edit_clears_redo
regression_tests.asserts: After undo, recording a new entry empties the redo stack and can_redo() is false.
